Press SPACE while airborne to double jump!
Hold SHIFT and press a direction to dash — great for dodging.
Dash into the ground while falling to cancel momentum.

Reload by pressing R — don't get caught empty in a fight.
Headshots deal bonus damage. Aim for the head!

Switching weapons mid-combo can catch opponents off guard.
Down-dash (Q) lets you slam into the ground fast.
Use the environment for cover — walls block shots.

Press ~ (tilde) to open the developer console.

Every body part collides — arms, legs, head, and weapons.
